copy.text: Matching seconds changes the fraction used at each update. Only decay is matched; pulse spacing is still in updates.
Run until the next pulse has been added, then pause on its result. The initial level does not count as the next pulse.
A crossing between updates is rounded up. A level beyond this strip cannot be reached here.
This compares the two flashes across updates 0–120. It pauses at the earliest largest difference; it does not compare the pulse train.
The first added pulse is half the chosen amount; the next is full. The initial level and the decay fraction do not change.
The initial level is always present. After the chosen additional pulses, only decay remains.
Look only after the final addition. The chosen fraction is relative to that peak, not to a full lamp.
Seek the first update at one in this 120-update experiment. If no pulse reaches the cap, this action is unavailable.
Inspect the scheduled pulse updates without running the clock. These slots remain even when a finite burst stops adding pulses.
This is the most recent added pulse, not the level at every later update. Clipped level is discarded by the toy’s cap.
Gold is the accepted part of the last pulse, after its later decay. Coral is earlier light. Both share the same zero-to-one scale; clipped input was never stored.
The dotted line is this update. Gold is the first flash, coral the second, and grey the pulse train; each dot matches its lamp.
Return restores the experiment and its update. It does not start the clock.

cases.title: Fading Light — Fold the pulse recipe without hiding its working lamp
cases.goal: The chosen train remains readable while its recipe is optional. Train configuration, questions about that train, and the working lamp become distinct things.
cases.steps: In .small-pulses create closed details #pulse-recipe immediately after its h2. Move only recipe controls into it, with their labels/wrappers and original help: pulse-amount, pulse-pattern-control, pulse-count and pulse-count-help, pulse-spacing. If a former pulse-count wrapper contains other controls, split that wrapper rather than moving unrelated children. Keep #pulse-inspection from700, scheduled slot buttons/help, train-uncapped-reader, train-level, arithmetic/help, lamp, pulse-amount-rule and pulse-parts OUTSIDE the recipe and otherwise in their existing order. Preserve actual input IDs/types/options and all runtime render/keep/Return readers. Only HTML/CSS structural changes, no JS setting handlers.
cases.message: pulse recipe settings fold without hiding the working lamp or its independent questions

cases.title: Fading Light — Keep the saved experiment optional and below the working chart
cases.goal: The current three curves answer the current experiment before its saved comparison. Keep/Return and the saved-curve choice share one optional door.
cases.steps: Wrap intact #light-memory section in closed details #light-memory-drawer at its existing position below .chart-section. Keep the section id and all saved count/pattern/readers and668 kept-curve choice/help inside it. Keep #kept-flash-curve in its original working-chart SVG; do not move or clone a plot. Opening/closing never checks the overlay, forgets memory or returns an experiment. No runtime JS change, only HTML/CSS structure.
cases.message: the current light chart leads an optional saved-experiment drawer without changing its overlay

cases.title: Fading Light — Put optional crossing and clock arithmetic in one readable drawer
cases.goal: The first lamp is an immediate result, not the end of a stack of explanations. The arithmetic is still available beside it and says the same thing.
cases.steps: Add closed details #flash-clock-notes after #first-flash-lamp. Move threshold-info, threshold-help, time-unit, half-level, half-time, rate-help and decay-unit-help into it in that order. Keep all control labels/selects and #seek-threshold outside, as well as flash-level, lamp, play-status, all transport controls and the final note distinguishing updates from seconds. Preserve every paragraph text and its ID; dynamic readers continue updating while folded. Do not move the un-id'd playback paragraph or alter elapsed-time playback. Only HTML/CSS changes.

groups.summary: Read the crossing and the clock

cases.message: optional crossing and clock arithmetic folds while the flash controls and result remain visible
